Record Class AdocManifest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.plugin.adoc.AdocManifest
Record Components:
groupId - the owning group, from coordinates
artifactId - the artifact, from coordinates
packages - the packages shipped, in manifest order
registry - the registry path relative to the root, or null when the manifest names none
public record AdocManifest(String groupId, String artifactId, List<AdocPackage> packages, String registry) extends Record
A library's manifest: its coordinates and the packages it ships, generated by the build from the pom and the tree and shipped at META-INF/ike/<group>/<artifact>/manifest.yaml (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1341). The union goal reads it to know what a zip puts in the union and to refuse two libraries that ship one package. 
coordinates: network.ike.lab:unlv-topics
packages:
  - name: network.ike.lab/aip
    kind: topics
  - name: network.ike.lab/unlv
    kind: library
registry: META-INF/ike/network.ike.lab/unlv-topics/topic-registry.yaml

A module of the same reactor has no zip at generate-sources, so its manifest is derived from its source tree with fromSourceTree(AdocCoordinates, Path): every directory under the root whose name has a dot is a group, a group directory that holds files directly is one package, and otherwise each directory under it is one. The manifest the doc plugin generates is the one a zip ships; the derived one is for linking the member into the union.

    • fromSourceTree

      public static AdocManifest fromSourceTree(AdocCoordinates coordinates, Path root)
      Derives the manifest of a reactor member from its source tree. A directory under the root is a group when its name has a dot and does not start with one. A group directory that holds a file directly is one package, as network.ike.kompendium.anf is; otherwise each directory under it is a package. A package is of kind "topics" when any .adoc file in it declares a :topic-id:, else "library". A root without any group directory, the legacy topics/ layout among them, yields no packages.
      Parameters:
      coordinates - the member's coordinates
      root - the member's AsciiDoc source root
      Returns:
      the derived manifest, with no registry path
      Throws:
      org.apache.maven.api.plugin.MojoException - if the tree cannot be read
